title: optimize-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-scheduling
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Reduce token-cost and tail latency for quantized models (INT8/FP8) by fusing dequant pathways and adapting kernel selection for smoothquant-scaled weights, while improving KV cache locality and continuous-batching scheduling. This PR implements a set of coordinated runtime changes: 1) new fused dequant+matmul kernels for INT8 and FP8 paths that avoid an extra dequant buffer copy for transformer attention and MLP, 2) smoothquant-aware per-channel scaling metadata propagation so kernels apply requantization in-register where possible, 3) lightweight runtime kernel selector that prefers the fused path when sequence length < 1024 and batch shapes match cache-friendly layout, 4) KV-cache prefetch/shard-aware layout change + a micro-scheduler hook to group requests by KV-shard affinity for continuous batching, 5) additional unit and perf tests and microbench harness to validate throughput/latency impact. Checklist: [x] fused kernels implemented and unit-tested, [x] kernel selector integrated, [x] KV cache layout change + scheduler hook implemented, [x] perf harness and benchmarks added, [x] docs (runtime/kernel selection) updated, [x] manual validation on p4d and a100 internal canary. Measured impact (internal perf lab): +28%-34% end-to-end throughput on quantized LLaMA-family models (INT8 path), median per-token latency reduced by 9%-12% at typical production tail loads; FP8 path similarly shows +18%-22% throughput with 6%-10% latency reduction. Notes: the fused kernel falls back to separate dequant path on older CUDA drivers (< 12.1) and on unsupported GPUs; the kernel selector is conservative by default and can be overridden via model/runtime config. This is a performance-first change but includes safety fallbacks to avoid regressions in correctness. Related: ENG-2489 (quant roadmap), ENG-2613 (kvcache scheduling), PERF-412 (bench harness).
